entrance.route: ACT-0001 -> EJECUCION_PERFIL_LF (SRCR) -> profile-owned capability invocation; no alternate Router operation
entrance.invocation_after: EJECUCION_PERFIL_LF semantic_judge(70) PASS on diagnosis, BEFORE terminal report_output(80); return to same active parent execution

process.proof: read parent run, Router receipt, scope, policy, exact main revision+target blob and SRCR diagnosis from LIVE DB; never trust client envelope
process.pattern_reused: IG profile-owned capability invocation: applicability decision -> executor-needed/READY receipt -> resume same parent run
process.parent_readback: Exact step50 profile output, step60 output validator and step70 independent semantic judge must be clean on current SRCR parent before requesting Updater
process.avoids: No new top-level Router path and no new profile begin/operation. SRCR delegates using existing governed profile-native continuation.
process.decision: RETURN_PROFILE_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED with one-use server-bound ticket (analogous to IG); never infer from an arbitrary JSON or from Router PROFILE_UPDATE directly
process.ticket_model: Short-lived single-use ticket bound server-side to active parent execution, profile code, target, scope, policy and requested capability; distinct consumer and authorization from IG CONTEXT_PACK

transport.profile_entry: Existing LF_PROFILE_NATIVE_BEGIN_REQUEST_V1 and RESUME_REQUEST_V1 route creates and advances parent SRCR; new capability call consumes parent context; Updater existing workflow issue+label/OIDC remains child technical dispatch

return.resume_parent: Same still-active EJECUCION_PERFIL_LF parent run; consume verified Updater child result before report_output(80); preserve evidence and revalidate final report, never restart Router
return.scope: only after child terminal receipt independent readback
return.resume_precondition: report_output(80) NOT recorded before capability return; if already terminal, reject continuation and require explicit governed remediation, no reopen
